title_zh: 商定首次志愿接待的分工

scenario.label_zh: 明确志愿参与和首次接待分工
scenario.goal_zh: 确认参加自愿且可调整，商定首次协助签到并问清联络对象

context_zh: 新志愿者向活动组织者了解首次帮忙的安排。
author: author-phase09-c

sentences.speaker: Mae
sentences.text: I'm willing to help at the welcome session, but I can't promise every Saturday.

sentences.speaker: Idris
sentences.text: That's fine. It's voluntary, and we arrange each session separately.

sentences.speaker: Mae
sentences.text: Could I work with someone the first time? I don't know the building yet.

sentences.speaker: Idris
sentences.text: Yes. Whoever takes the reception desk will show you the sign-in sheet. This Saturday, that will be me.

sentences.speaker: Mae
sentences.text: Good. To whom should I send a message if my plans change?

sentences.speaker: Idris
sentences.text: Send it directly to me. For now, shall we put you down to help me with sign-in at ten?

sentences.speaker: Mae
sentences.text: Yes, that suits me. I'll join you at ten.
